correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 and 1<=k<n, translating the capped cube P_{n,k} by s1 (0<s<k/n) yields the polar of the signed-axis crosspolytope augmented by v=1/(k-ns)1. Each signed-coordinate simplex facet indexed by j positive coordinates has visible height ratio (j-k)/(k-ns), so disjoint exterior pyramids sum to the exact binomial-tail volume W. Strict convexity of the polar-volume integral and symmetric uniqueness give a unique center along the diagonal and the displayed stationary polynomial. For k=n-1, differentiation reduces to the root equation and an O(2^{-n}/n) bound yields the normalized shift. Independent exact rational signed-facet summation matched the rational function for 20 parameter/center choices with n=2..5, k=1..n-1. These finite checks do not prove the general formula.
residual_risks: The limiting displacement statement is for k=n-1 and n>=3 only, not other rank regimes.
